producer: Zaheen solver-evidence driver (scenario/evaluator from tests/reference_contract.py, a transcription of architecture.md §4; to be superseded by src/pipeline.run_scenario)

model.penalty_derivation: single-flip bound B = max_i(max(c_i,0) + sum_j W_ij); B = 6.5 attained at A_N; P = B + margin guarantees every infeasible state has a strictly lower-energy feasible neighbour

hamiltonian.bitstring_convention: Qiskit little-endian: printed string reversed gives (x0..x7)

selection.selection_rule: highest true utility among sampled assignments that pass the original is_feasible; ties -> higher count, then smallest canonical tuple

run.optimizer_message: Return from COBYLA because the trust region radius reaches its lower bound.

exact.tie_breaker: highest total_utility; ties (|ΔU| <= 1e-9) broken by the lexicographically smallest canonical tuple (x0, ..., x7)

notes: All utilities, costs and batteries are synthetic (architecture.md §4).
QAOA expectation evaluated with StatevectorEstimator (exact); final samples from seeded StatevectorSampler.
Exact baseline enumerates all 256 assignments with the original constraint checker; it never sees QAOA output.
No quantum speedup is claimed; exhaustive search is faster at this size.
